newsitem.title: FRANCE: LVMH no comment on KKR DFS bid report.
newsitem.headline: LVMH no comment on KKR DFS bid report.

text.p: French flagship luxury goods maker LVMH did not comment on a newspaper report that Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co is interested in making a bid for DFS Group Ltd, a U.S. based duty free retailer.
An official at company headquarters in Paris said no one would be available to comment on the report until early afternoon.
The Wall Street Journal reported on Friday that KKR had told DFS' four controlling shareholders that it was interested in submitting a bid.
It said it did not have the price KKR might offer. The paper said the shareholders were divided over whether to consider a new offer.
LVMH agreed to pay $2.47 billion for 58.75 percent of the group last month.
LVMH shares were trading at 1,258 francs, down 0.47 percent on the Paris bourse at 1000 GMT.
The newspaper report quoted an LVMH spokesman as rejecting the KKR bid.
